fields.v:
Agent = custom single-shot harness (no execution, temperature 0, max_tokens 8000, <= 2 apply retries) with Claude Sonnet 4.6 (alias claude-sonnet-4-6) for all resolve arms. Criterion: SWE-bench resolution; cost = mean context tokens and tokens per resolve (Table 3); whole registered run about $20 API for ~210 calls. Single run, N = 70. All arms are oracle ceilings.
- oracle_full + single-shot harness + Claude Sonnet 4.6: 19/70 = 0.271 [0.18, 0.39]; 25,426 mean tokens; 93,700 tokens/resolve
- oracle_tier + harness + Sonnet 4.6: 23/70 = 0.329 [0.23, 0.44]; 8,629; 26,300
- oracle_keep_drop + harness + Sonnet 4.6: 25/70 = 0.357 [0.26, 0.47]; 6,876; 19,300 (re-run: 23/70)
- keep/drop + sequence slice (follow-up, pre-registered H3) + harness + Sonnet 4.6: 26/70 = 0.371 [0.27, 0.49] vs keep/drop re-run 23/70; slice mean 215 extra tokens (present on 65/70)
Probe study (answerer Claude Sonnet 4.6, no agent; n = 45; Table 2): full source 0.600 (27/45), 1,124 tokens; summary by Sonnet 4.6 0.089 (4/45), 165 tokens; summary by Qwen2.5-Coder-3B 0.089 (4/45), 180 tokens; signature + docstring 0.133 (6/45), 212 tokens
Verdicts: quality and cost: no criterion stated by the authors (all configurations)
